player_prompt.intro:
Ikaw so Player {player_id}. Ikaw so naspal na angga ed Battleship. 
Say goal yo et sanken yo amin so saray ship na kalaban yo bago sanken ira so ship yo.
Ed turn yo, pwede yo magpaputok ed missile ed spesipikong koordinado ed sungriring format: '[a4]'. No nakagat so missile ed ship, markado ed 'X'. No napaltak, markado ed 'O'. Ed duara scenario, say environment na laro informa yo ed hit yo. No sanken yo ed bangka, say environment na laro inggaga yo!
Say laro tapos no sanken ira amin so saray ship na saray player.
Say initial board yo ampay show amin so saray ship yo na na-place, tan say hit na kalaban yo ed yo, tan say hit tan miss yo ed board na kalaban yo sanen show so ship na kalaban yo.
